method: Independent source-only exact-byte review; read LightSpanners.Construction.greedyOutput_preliminaries and MinorFreeSpanners.Greedy.greedy_minorFree contracts. No compiler used.
checks: The stretch is the actual (1+epsilon)*(2r-1), and r>=1,epsilon>0 yield its required stretch>=1.
The invoked ordered greedy preliminaries supply the literal greedy spanner, exact weighted-girth threshold stretch+1 and an actual retained MST of the original graph.
Minor exclusion passes to the actual greedy subgraph. Every spanning tree of that subgraph is an original-graph spanning tree, so the same original MST is also minimum in the greedy graph.

The previously reviewed normalized lightness theorem is invoked on that exact output and exact tree; the denominator is the original MST weight, rather than an arbitrary cheaper tree or substituted witness.
scope: Connected finite simple graph, at least two vertices, h>=3, r>=1, 0<epsilon<=1; this wrapper explicitly assumes positivity of w for every Sym2 label, including nonedges.
Exact coefficient and actual greedy spanner are established in the statement. Asymptotic simplification, broader/degenerated domains, construction runtime and whole-paper completion remain separate.
The source is outside published452; complete local/remote gates remain separate.
